checks.name: fixed bundled identities authenticate exact source bytes and reject a changed source
activation is detached, immutable and registered at the verified current cursor
selected policy has exact terms and no event, accepted-loan or global-fact claim
missing and empty grants produce no knowledge, including for another NPC
actor, world, branch, exact cursor and pinned identity mismatches are refused
fixed helpers refuse attacker-chosen pack, catalog and pins
shape validation does not claim to authenticate caller-selected knowledge
hostile objects, oversized selections, sparse arrays and cycles are refused without effects
legacy 0.1 preserves its closed field set and an actual request contains no authored terms
public model path sends exact Melia terms and no private pack, authority or narrator data
another NPC request cannot acquire Melia policy by sharing the campaign
cache scope distinguishes dialogue version 0.1 and 0.2
grant revocation during token counting prevents generation
grant or content binding changes during generation suppress the proposed command
knowledge views outside validity or future acquisition fail before the model call

limitations: Fixtures exercise actual provider request construction with injected responses; no live model prose quality or latency result.
Host authentication, persisted activation and earlier-prefix ancestry are trusted integration obligations; JSON shape and hash matching do not prove them.
